subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should embedded-agent hook contexts permanently expose the additive, current-session-scoped `resetSession` API with lifecycle-owned deferred execution?
rationale: The implementation now has a defensible safety shape, but adding a plugin-facing API and defining which embedded hook lifecycles provide it are product and compatibility choices that cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Approve scoped API
options.body: Accept the current-session-only contract, require live lifecycle proof, and document or test its supported hook-context availability before merge.

options.title: Keep reset internal
options.body: Remove the public hook-context method and route the known compaction use case through an internal owner-specific lifecycle seam.

options.title: Pause the API
options.body: Hold the PR until a canonical plugin use case or linked issue establishes the required public contract and hook coverage.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped API
recommendation.body: Accept the current-session-only contract, require live lifecycle proof, and document or test its supported hook-context availability before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision belongs to the merged-history owner of the agents/runtime and plugin-hook contract, but that person could not be established from the supplied snapshot.
